interface.signature: def simulate_program(n: int, a: list[int]) -> list[int]: ...

preconditions.description: n is an integer between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n - 1 and all(1 <= ai <= 10**9 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: a is a list of n-1 positive integers, each between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output list has exactly n-1 elements, one for each i in 1..n-1.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(y, int) for y in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each output element is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(y == -1 or (y >= 0 and y <= 10**18) for y in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each output y is either -1 (non-termination) or a non-negative integer (final y value).

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == simulate_single_run(i + 1, a) for i in range(n - 1))
postconditions.description: For each i in 1..n-1, the i-th output is the final y value (or -1) when running the program on sequence [i] + a.
